relations.quote: This map preserves [convolution](convolution.md) on the axes, so a cyclic product of two lists on $\mathbb{Z}_N$ becomes a product on the prime axes.
The map is applied to the radix-digit coefficient list produced by [reduction of integer product to digit convolution](radix-digit-reduction.md).
The map's axis moves are costed in the [fixed-tape machine model and stream operations](fixed-tape-model.md).

symbols.name: list length
symbols.meaning: The number of coefficients in the list, which equals the product of the $t$ distinct primes.
symbols.quote: Let $N$, the number of coefficients in the list, be written $N = P_1 P_2 \cdots P_t$, where $t$ is the number of distinct primes and $P_\ell$ is the $\ell$-th of them.

symbols.name: prime count
symbols.meaning: The number of distinct primes whose product is $N$, which is also the number of axes.
symbols.quote: Let $N$, the number of coefficients in the list, be written $N = P_1 P_2 \cdots P_t$, where $t$ is the number of distinct primes and $P_\ell$ is the $\ell$-th of them.

symbols.name: prime axis length
symbols.meaning: The $\ell$-th of the distinct primes, which is the length of the $\ell$-th cyclic axis.
symbols.quote: Let $N$, the number of coefficients in the list, be written $N = P_1 P_2 \cdots P_t$, where $t$ is the number of distinct primes and $P_\ell$ is the $\ell$-th of them.

symbols.name: axis index
symbols.meaning: The position of an axis among the $t$ axes, running from 1 to $t$.
symbols.quote: Let $N$, the number of coefficients in the list, be written $N = P_1 P_2 \cdots P_t$, where $t$ is the number of distinct primes and $P_\ell$ is the $\ell$-th of them.

symbols.name: residue axis
symbols.meaning: The set of residues modulo $P_\ell$, which is the $\ell$-th cyclic axis.
symbols.quote: Each $\mathbb{Z}_{P_\ell}$, the set of residues modulo $P_\ell$, is one axis of length $P_\ell$, and an axis is cyclic because its values wrap around modulo its length.
